# Reference test vectors

These static JSON files contain configuration outputs, signed MeshCore packets, observer status, and signed map upload requests captured before the repository switched to a Rust-only implementation. They are retained as independent regression expectations, not regenerated by the code under test.

- `config-golden.json`: environment resolution, signing key validation, log color, and time-zone cases.
- `protocol-golden.json`: valid and invalid advert wire packets.
- `runtime-golden.json`: observer status, packet hex, and expected signed HTTP requests.

When intentionally changing a contract, document why and derive new expected values independently (for example, from the published MeshCore protocol or a known-good signed payload). Do not generate expected signatures using the Rust uploader being tested. No secret production values should be added here.
